source: PO FIC-9301. Buyer: Fictional Cedar Workshop. Currency choices: EUR / GBP; none selected. Requested delivery for this order: 2028-06-12. Order-entry table columns: generic article code | description | package information | ordered quantity | ordered unit. Row: ART-A7 | Violet clips | 60 clips per carton | [blank] | cartons. Row: ART-B9 | Amber washers | 18 washers per carton | 2 | cartons. Row: ART-C4 | Silver hooks | 25 hooks per carton | 0 | cartons. No printed business line numbers, buyer-owned product codes, prices, issue date or line-specific dates are stated.
explanation: Only the positive ordered-quantity row is ordered here. Package count 18 is not ordered quantity. The generic article code is not buyer-owned. An order delivery date is not a line date. Unselected currency choices establish no currency. Table position establishes no printed line number.

source: PO FIC-5082 issued 2028-02-19. Buyer: Fictional Meadow Lab. Currency: EUR. Order-level service date: 2028-03-25. First ordered line, printed line 007: product Copper spacer; buyer-owned product code 00073-Z; seller code SELL-Q8; ordered quantity 3; unit pieces; requested delivery for this line 2028-03-21. Second ordered line, printed line 009: product Copper spacer; buyer-owned product code 00073-Z; seller code SELL-Q8; ordered quantity 5; unit pieces; no line-specific delivery date. No price or PO total is stated.
explanation: Repeated products remain two separate ordered lines. Explicit buyer-owned codes and printed line numbers retain leading zeros. The seller code has a different role. Only the first line has its own delivery date; the order-level service date is not copied to the second.

source: PO FIC-7420. Explicit buyer: Fictional Maple Studio. In the catalog, Cobalt rinse, package 0.75 litre per bottle, generic code MIX-W6, is marked SELECTED: ORDER THIS PRODUCT. Its ordered quantity box is unreadable. The ordered unit is bottles. Another catalog entry, Quartz polish, has no order mark and a blank ordered quantity. No buyer product code, printed line number, date, price, currency or total is available.
explanation: Explicit item selection establishes order membership even though quantity is unavailable. Retain the ordered line with null quantity; do not substitute package size 0.75. The other unselected catalog entry is excluded. A generic code still does not establish a buyer identifier.
